name: Pay 2 life for a shockland that unlocks a hand card on turn 1-2
intent: On turn 1 or 2, once open-land-unlocks has had first refusal, play a shockland from hand (Breeding Pool, Steam Vents, Stomping Ground) and pay the 2 life when doing so makes some other hand card payable that is not payable now - Steam Vents unlocking Curator of Mysteries' Cycling {U}. A free untapped land always wins when one is available (this play's false repeats U's own key), and a tapped-entering land in hand also stands this down (U's own new false key, repeated here for the same reason - see open-land-unlocks), and life stays unspent below 8. Also stands down once a fetch in hand could reach the same kind of unlock for a free BASIC (F's own true key, unlocks_by_basic_search rather than the broader unlocks_by_search - narrowed so P no longer wrongly defers to F on a hand whose only fetch reach is itself a non-basic shock, which F never touches any more either; see open-fetch-unlocks). Only turns 1-2, land drop available, mine, precombat main, empty stack.
